VideoCallTranscript.name: VideoCallTranscript
VideoCallTranscript.description: Represents the complete transcript text and metadata of a recorded video call.

IsTranscriptTruncated.description: Required. Indicates whether the transcript is truncated (true) or not (false). The default value is false.

Name.description: The unique name for the video call transcript record.

TotalDuration.description: Required. The difference between the end timestamp of the last entry and the start timestamp of the first entry in the transcript. This field helps identify the longest transcript for a given call. The unit of measurement is seconds.

TranscribedLanguage.description: The language in which the transcript is generated.

TranscriptContent.description: The full content of the video call transcript in the JSON or CSV format, including all spoken sentences during the call, with timestamps and speaker information.

TranscriptCreationTimestamp.description: Required. The date and time when the transcript was created by the transcription service.

Type.description: Required. Specifies how the transcript was generated.

UsageType.description: Required. The source from where the video call originated.

VideoCallId.description: Required. Reference to the associated parent video call.

VideoCallRecordingId.description: Reference to the associated optional parent video call recording.

VideoCallStartTimestamp.description: The start time of the video call recording to use with the transcript for calculating relative timestamps.
